# Feedback

Issues are welcome: a wrong result, a library that is not detected, or a confusing message. Include the code, what
pqc-scan printed and what you expected.

I am not merging pull requests. I write every change myself, and a report with the code that shows the problem is the
most useful thing you can send.

To run the tests or see how the code is organised, read [docs/development.md](../docs/development.md).
